mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations and anticholinergic/CNS effects; both drugs increase CNS depression risk.
action: Monitor for increased tricyclic toxicity (anticholinergic effects, sedation, arrhythmias); consider dose reduction of nortriptyline or use alternative antidepressant if possible.
